author: Chris Titus Tech
description:
After 794 days on Arch Linux, I'm switching to Fedora — and it has nothing to do with the recent AUR compromise. Here's why constant rolling-release updates became a productivity killer, and how I built my own minimal Fedora spin with DWM and QuickShell to replace it.

In this video I cover:
- Why the AUR "hack" panic is overblown
- How Arch was costing me dev time
- Why I picked Fedora over Debian
- My custom DWM + QuickShell setup
- Fedora's SELinux & FirewallD defaults
- Why I'm building my own Fedora ISO
- Red Hat's CentOS/Rocky history
- Final thoughts on Arch vs Fedora

🔗 Full writeup: https://christitus.com/switch-from-arch-to-fedora/
